components.name: One-sided semigroup versus bidirectional gcd contact precision
components.project_addition: Classify the E001 Boolean-contact predictive state by action-language directionality. For one-sided positive gap actions, prove exact horizon and stable class counts from actually reachable cumulative semigroup thresholds and characterize when the gcd coordinate is minimal by absence of relevant semigroup holes. For any signed action language containing at least one positive and one negative move, prove the nonnegative action monoid equals the full gcd subgroup gZ and recover K=ceil((d-x)/g) as the exact coarsest arbitrary-future Boolean-contact quotient. This strictly corrects the earlier over-strong suggestion that paired +/- magnitude symmetry itself is necessary.
